# ThingsBoard

[![Join the chat at https://gitter.im/thingsboard/chat](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/5dbac0213da25c445bd11f168587c11a200ba153ef3014e8408e462e410169b3/68747470733a2f2f6261646765732e6769747465722e696d2f4a6f696e253230436861742e737667)](https://gitter.im/thingsboard/chat?utm_source=badge&utm_medium=badge&utm_campaign=pr-badge&utm_content=badge) [![ThingsBoard Builds Server Status](https://camo.githubusercontent.)](https://builds.thingsboard.io/viewType.html?buildTypeId=ThingsBoard_Build&guest=1)

ThingsBoard is an open-source IoT platform for data collection, processing, visualization, and device management.

[![](https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/raw/master/img/logo.png?raw=true)](https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard/blob/master/img/logo.png?raw=true)

## [](https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard#documentation)Documentation

ThingsBoard documentation is hosted on [thingsboard.io](https://thingsboard.io/docs).

## [](https://github.com/thingsboard/thingsboard#iot-use-cases)IoT use cases

[**Smart energy**](https://thingsboard.io/smart-energy/) [![Smart energy](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8308069/152984256-eb48564a-645c-468d-912b-f554b63104a5.gif "Smart energy")](https://thingsboard.io/smart-energy/)

[**Fleet tracking**](https://thingsboard.io/fleet-tracking/) [![Fleet tracking](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8308069/152984528-0054ed55-8b8b-4cda-ba45-02fe95a81222.gif "Fleet tracking")](https://thingsboard.io/fleet-tracking/)

[**Smart farming**](https://thingsboard.io/smart-farming/) [![Smart farming](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8308069/152984443-a98b7d3d-ff7a-4037-9011-e71e1e6f755f.gif "Smart farming")](https://thingsboard.io/smart-farming/)

[**IoT Rule Engine**](https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/re-getting-started/) [![IoT Rule Engine](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/02e14455bcd2eb32281fb2298521a0364fdf6429d0ea6724c206f460b13cb79e/68747470733a2f2f7468696e6773626f6172642e696f2f696d616765732f64656d6f2f73656e642d656d61696c2d72756c652d636861696e2e676966 "IoT Rule Engine")](https://thingsboard.io/docs/user-guide/rule-engine-2-0/re-getting-started/)

[**Smart metering**](https://thingsboard.io/smart-metering/) [![Smart metering](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8308069/31455788-6888a948-aec1-11e7-9819-410e0ba785e0.gif "Smart metering")](https://thingsboard.io/smart-metering/)
